response.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct
  FROM observatory_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share_pct) AS share_pct
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
       AVG(s.share_pct - a.share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share_pct > a.share_pct;

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories represented by at least one telescope are included, since the request specifies observstation values in the telescopes table.
